title: the model servers start without the prefix cache

findings.claim: no judge or verifier server command named the prefix cache, so the model server's own default (on) applied on every box; the integrator's bench saw runs differ with it on and agree with it off
the cluster manifests (deploy/platform/components/gpu-pair/llm.yaml) start both servers with no prefix-cache flag; the same change there needs the trialbox-serving config map to carry the value
the bench-only second engine's overlay (docker-compose.serving-second.yml) replaces the command with another engine's; whether that engine caches prefixes, and its flag, is not covered
the time the prefix cache saves or costs is not measured by this card; the integrator measures it on the bench copy before the box takes the update
